messages:
anna_pm: Quick sync — we need a finalized data consent matrix for Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant connector listing. Who will own each row? Need decision by EOD Wed for marketplace go/no-go.

mike_partner_eng: I can own Snowflake rows. Question: do we need sample customer data or synthetic for the validation? :thinking: 

jen_eng: For eng validation we only take synthetic samples. infra wants S3 staging + field-level masking. Example masking config I used for Aurora:
```
redaction:
  fields: [email, ssn]
  method: hash
  salt: env(RED_SALT)
```
Works for dbx too with external stage.

saira_legal: We need DP sign-off. Two quick rules: samples must be synthetic OR fully hashed+salted; and any 3rd-party connector listing requires a DPA addendum with explicit processing purposes. I'll drop required clause snippets in a bit.

tom_sales: Timelines? marketing wants joint announcement two weeks after listing approval. If legal needs extra time we should shift collateral schedule.

integrations-bot: Checklist created: /docs/marketplace/connector-consent-checklist.md — added tasks: sample-sanitization, contract-addendum, telemetry-allowed-fields. Assigned default reviewers: @saira_legal, @jen_eng.

mike_partner_eng: Noted. Also flag: Snowflake external functions don't allow certain binary payloads — may affect telemetry. I'll add a compatibility note in the matrix.

jen_eng: Heads-up: Databricks streaming ingest path emits user metadata in headers. We'll strip headers at ingress by default. Proposed fallback: if masking fails, route to Dedicated (no sample extraction) and flag as manual-only.

saira_legal: I'll paste the clause we need for the marketplace listing:
"Customer data will not be stored beyond transient processing necessary for index creation. Any samples used for validation must be synthetic or irreversibly masked."

anna_pm: Action items:
- mike_partner_eng: complete Snowflake rows + compat notes (due Tue 11:59 PDT)
- jen_eng: add masking config and redaction script + verify DBX headers (due Tue 5pm)
- saira_legal: DPA addendum draft + clause text (due Wed EOD)
- tom_sales: tentative PR timeline + embargo window (sync with marketing)

mike_partner_eng: Will do. I'll also attach an example sanitize script later today.

jen_eng: quick redaction script (PoC):
```
#!/bin/bash
cat sample.csv | jq '.[] | .email |= sha256' > sanitized.csv
```
Use with gov-salt from vault.

saira_legal: thanks. If you can put the script in the checklist link above I'll mark DP review as in progress.

anna_pm: OK — let's reconvene Thu morning for signoffs. If anyone can't make it DM me. :white_check_mark:

tom_sales: copy — I'll push announcement hold to marketing and update calendar.

integrations-bot: Reminder scheduled: reconvene Thu 09:30 PT — @channel

anna_pm: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turn here. :rocket:
